title: Select the correct optimization candidate · Set 2
statement:
Minimize the total surface area of a closed cylinder of volume $2\pi([$a])^3$; give the optimal height.

[__________]{a}
hints: Use the volume to eliminate height.
Substitute that radius into the volume equation to recover height.
solution: $S(r)=2\pi r^2+4\pi([$a])^3/r$ decreases below $r=[$a]$ and increases above it. Then $h=2([$a])$.
